A student defines three periods of time:
●
the time TS taken for the Earth to orbit the Sun
●
the time TR taken for the Earth to rotate once on its axis
●
the time TM taken for the Moon to orbit the Earth.
Which row shows the shortest period of time and the longest period of time?
